messages.content: 一個物理實驗正在進行，兩個物體從高處被放下，忽略空氣阻力。第一個物體的初始速度為0公尺/秒，第二個物體的初始速度為5公尺/秒。如果第一個物體自由落體10秒，第二個物體自由落體7秒，您能計算出兩個物體的最終速度嗎？考慮到重力加速度為-9.81公尺/秒^2。

function.name: calculate_final_speed
function.description: Calculate the final speed of an object in free fall after a certain time, neglecting air resistance. The acceleration due to gravity is considered as -9.81 m/s^2 Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object in m/s. Default is 0 for an object at rest.

time.description: The time in seconds for which the object is in free fall.

gravity.description: The acceleration due to gravity. Default is -9.81 m/s^2. This is a float type value.
